title: cenchrus villosus
intro: Cenchrus villosus, commonly known as the hairy spurge, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions such as eczema and dermatitis. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Cenchrus villosus include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
